name: @metaphor/metaphor-ui
description: Interactive terminal UI for the Metaphor CLI — manifest-driven menus, guided forms, and a workspace overview.

scripts.build:
esbuild src/main.tsx --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/main.js --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --alias:react-devtools-core=./src/shims/empty.ts
